steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Compare. Each assumption and target is matched to its source and baseline; each total is checked against them.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Assumption with no source
findings.fix: Name the source of the assumption

findings.title: Target with no baseline
findings.fix: Record last year's actual as the baseline

findings.title: Plan total does not follow from the assumptions

outcome.notChecked: Market conditions not in the notes.

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] assume-price.md:12  Assumption with no source.
       Fix: Name the source of the assumption.
[medium] target-revenue.md:19  Target with no baseline.
       Fix: Record last year's actual as the baseline.
[low] plan-total.csv:26  Plan total does not follow from the assumptions.
       Fix: Recompute the total.
Not checked: Market conditions not in the notes.
pros: Checks an assumption with no source, a target with no baseline, and a plan total that does not follow from the assumptions.
cons: Not checked: Market conditions not in the notes.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-fin-next-year-plan skill on the records for this review.
